findings.detail: The Background & Objectives section includes a transaction amount despite the requirement to keep such amounts in Recommendations or Tax Implications. The report also leaves the Holloway platform charge rate unspecified and does not set out platform charges for the other platforms, so Fees & Charges does not meet its brief.
report_quote: James and Caroline Whitmore have recently navigated a significant life event with the sale of James's business, receiving a completion payment of £850,000.
The exact rate will depend on the total amount invested and will be confirmed in our subsequent communications.

findings.detail: The £240,000 GIA figure was from the older snapshot; the meeting note says its live value was around £255,000. Calling £240,000 the current value shifts the source's timing. The meeting agreed pension contributions at an appropriate level, not necessarily the maximum allowed.
report_quote: Based on your current joint GIA value of approximately £240,000
maxing out contributions to each SIPP according to the limits

findings.detail: The report silently ignores the handling notes' instruction to attend to valuation dates: it treats an older GIA valuation as current. It also does not distinguish the received completion payment from the separate, conditional earnout, and this recommendation does not make clear that £200,000 of the completion payment is committed to loan repayment. It does not leak the notes' wording.
report_quote: Based on your current joint GIA value of approximately £240,000

In light of the recent sale of your business and the completion payment of £850,000 now held in a solicitor's client account, we recommend a structured approach to invest these funds in a way that aligns with your long-term growth objectives and risk appetite.

findings.detail: The opening contains a broken sentence and a double full stop. Repeated account tables and summaries make the report much longer and harder to follow than necessary.

findings.detail: No adviser-review markers were supplied for assessment.
